_written: 2026-11-04, after the census (rules.json) results had been seen and before ClinVar was queried or any truth-set count was made. Approved by the user ('Approve all'). B3 replaces the census AlphaGenome rule post hoc: the quantile < 0.99 rule had been seen to pass almost no promoter SNV.
windows: windows.tsv; elements = LDLR, HBB, GATA2_IS, GATA2_IG, SLC39A4 (W1+W2, each variant counted once)

pathogenic_candidates.source: ClinVar via NCBI E-utilities, queried 2026-11-04: esearch '<chrom>[chr] AND <start>:<end>[chrpos38]' per window + esummary (same query as tools/r01_figure/clinical.py)
pathogenic_candidates.rule: germline classification Pathogenic, Likely pathogenic or Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic (not 'Conflicting'), any review status; SNVs and indels whose GRCh38 SPDI lies in the window (indel rule as census_lib.in_window)
pathogenic_candidates.context: VUS, conflicting and B/LB counted alongside; HGMD not used (licence)

benign_candidates.clinvar: ClinVar Benign, Likely benign or Benign/Likely benign (established benign set), same query
benign_candidates.B1_common: gnomAD v4.1 genomes PASS, alt AF > 1% in at least one genetic-ancestry group with AN >= 2000 (primary); overall AF > 1% also reported
benign_candidates.B2_not_eqtl: not a significant single-tissue eQTL for ANY gene in GTEx V10 (Portal singleTissueEqtl by variant). Shown as: significant / tested, not significant (maf01) / not tested. 'Not tested' counts as passing B2 but is flagged.

B3_predicted_no_effect.alphagenome: no large change in BOTH AlphaGenome RNA (target gene, gene-mask LFC) and AlphaGenome DNase (501-bp center mask): large change = |mean raw score over the element's track set| in the element's top 20% across all possible SNVs of that element (the Figure 3 panel b rule). Track sets: LDLR HepG2 (EFO:0001187, as panel b); HBB RNA K562 + venous blood, DNase K562; GATA2 RNA K562 + CMP CD34+ + hematopoietic multipotent progenitor, DNase same; SLC39A4 RNA small intestine + Caco-2, DNase same.
B3_predicted_no_effect.indels: PromoterAI has no indel scores, so indels cannot pass B3 (reported as not scored)

benign_candidates.candidate_benign: B1 and B2 and B3 (primary = any-group AF); also the overall-AF version and the strict version (B2 requires tested)

outputs: results/promoter_variant_census_20261104/truth_sets/: clinvar_variants.tsv, truth_sets.tsv (counts per element), candidates.tsv (every common variant with B1-B3 evidence), summary.json

gata2_enhancer._written: 2026-11-04, user asked to replace the GATA2 promoters with the +9.5 intronic enhancer and gave the FIRE peak chr3:128482922-128483424; before any enhancer variant was retrieved (the three ClinVar P/LP enhancer variants had been seen while locating the element)
gata2_enhancer.windows: GATA2_E95_W1 chr3:128482922-128483221 and GATA2_E95_W2 chr3:128483125-128483424 (windows.tsv; 97-bp overlap; union 503 bp = the FIRE peak)
gata2_enhancer.rules: same as the promoters (ClinVar, gnomAD, GTEx any gene) except B3 = AlphaGenome RNA (GATA2) and DNase only: PromoterAI is a promoter model and has no precomputed scores > 500 bp from a TSS (not applicable, not counted as failing). AlphaGenome track set = GATA2 set (K562, CMP CD34+, hematopoietic multipotent progenitor); one 1 Mb interval centred on the W1+W2 union; top-20% rule over the 1,509 possible SNVs of the union.
gata2_enhancer.figure: the enhancer replaces both GATA2 promoter rows in Figure 3 panel c; promoter rows stay in the census tables
